tagline: Developing Sustainable Affordable Housing and Renewable Energy Solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The flagship Sage Ranch project comprises 995 affordable housing units under construction in California, representing the company's most advanced residential pipeline and generating significant social impact on housing accessibility.

kpis.name: Sage Ranch Housing Units
kpis.explanation: Total number of affordable housing units under construction in the flagship Sage Ranch project in California.
kpis.description: The Sage Ranch project comprises 995 affordable housing units on 138 acres in Tehachapi, California. This project qualified Greenbriar for listing as a Tier 2 issuer on the TSXV as a real estate developer.
kpis.signal: Large-scale green housing project in California

kpis.name: Planned Solar Capacity
kpis.explanation: Maximum power in megawatts alternating current planned for solar energy projects developed and operated by Greenbriar.
kpis.description: Greenbriar will build, own and operate two solar energy production facilities with total capacity of 90 MW alternating current (AC) pursuant to a power purchase agreement signed in November 2021 with West Lake Energy Corp. The first site will have a capacity of 30 MW AC.
kpis.signal: Long-term solar energy supply agreement in Canada with West Lake Energy

kpis.name: Annual Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Net loss recorded during the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Greenbriar recorded a net loss of $5.1 million for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, compared to a loss of $2.8 million in 2023. The higher loss in 2024 is attributable to accretion and interest expenses on additional convertible debt, as well as non-recurring items related to modifications to joint venture agreements.
kpis.signal: Increased net loss in 2024 due to financing expenses and accounting adjustments

kpis.name: Cash Position
kpis.explanation: Cash and cash equivalents balance at end of period.
kpis.description: Greenbriar had an overdraft balance of $54,227 CAD as of December 31, 2024, compared to $47,098 in 2023. The company depends on access to external financing to continue operations.
kpis.signal: Negative cash position indicating dependence on external financing

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets on the consolidated balance sheet.
kpis.description: Greenbriar's total assets were $20.3 million as of December 31, 2024, up from $18.1 million in 2023, reflecting continued capitalization of costs related to Sage Ranch and Montalva.
kpis.signal: Total asset growth supported by project development investments

kpis.name: Land Area
kpis.explanation: Total land area of the Sage Ranch project in acres.
kpis.description: The Sage Ranch project is located on 138 acres of residential land in Tehachapi, California, acquired by Greenbriar in September 2011 and approved as a qualifying transaction by the TSXV in October 2011.
kpis.signal: Major land base for residential real estate development in California

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.01 Bn € last year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the past 4 years.

risks.title: Dependence on Regulatory Approval in Puerto Rico
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the document (repeated mention in several paragraphs), with strong language (no assurance, excluded from approval). The trend is stable but critical, as the Montalva project depends on final approvals from PREB and FOMB. The Regulation category is highly strategic for energy projects.

risks.title: Risk of Site Loss in Case of Non-Renewal
risks.score_rationale: The risk is well positioned in the text (specific paragraph on land leases), with concerning language (no assurance, prevented from proceeding). The trend is stable, but the 2025 deadline creates increasing pressure. The Industrial category is key for real estate and solar development projects.

risks.title: Uncertain Solar Irradiance Performance
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned with strong language (materially different than estimates, differ significantly). It is stable but fundamental, as project profitability depends directly on solar irradiance. The Technology category is central for photovoltaic projects.

risks.title: Construction Delays and Cost Overruns
risks.score_rationale: The risk is repeated several times with strong language (material delays, cost overruns, vendor non-performance). The trend is stable but critical, as projects are in development phase. The Industrial category is major for construction projects.

risks.title: Dependence on Extreme Weather Conditions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is well documented with alarming language (material adverse effect, hurricane, flooding). The trend is stable but aggravated by climate change. The Environmental category is critical for coastal assets like Montalva.

risks.title: Competition on Electricity Purchase Pricing
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implicit but clear (mention of pricing less than or similar to RFP contracts). The language is measured but strategic. The trend is stable, but competitive pressure on solar rates is increasing. The Competition category is crucial for PPA profitability.

risks.title: Cyber-Attacks on Energy Systems
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned (cyber-attack in the threats list). The language is factual but serious. The trend is stable, but the energy sector is increasingly targeted. The Cybersecurity category is strategic for critical infrastructure.

risks.title: Dependence on Key Partner for Sage Ranch
risks.score_rationale: The risk is well described (relationship with Captiva Verde Wellness Corp.). The language is concerning (continue to have net profits interest). The trend is stable, but the payment of 48 monthly installments is critical. The Key-Person category applies here to a strategic partner.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in the provided documents. Greenbriar focuses on green real estate development and renewable energy.
